sources.entry: AVXCAssets Generator - Takes path for your assets images and creates appiconset and imageset for you in just one click.

summary.one_liner: A macOS tool that takes a folder of source images and generates Xcode .xcassets-ready AppIcon.appiconset and imageset bundles in one step, scaled to the required sizes.
summary.what_it_does: The README says the tool takes a path to your asset images and creates appiconset and imageset folders for you in one click, so you don't have to resize and drag each image into an XCAssets file by hand. It is aimed at producing icon and image assets scaled to multiple aspect ratios. The README links to a download but gives no details on the exact input formats, output sizes, or how the app is built. It also has a short contributing note inviting pull requests and gives the author's contact details for feedback.
use_cases: generate iOS app icon sets from a single image
create imageset folders for Xcode asset catalogs
scale images to multiple aspect ratios for app assets
batch prepare assets for an Xcode project
avoid manually dragging images into XCAssets
how_to_run: Download AVXCAssets Generator from the link in the README
notable: Outputs both appiconset and imageset folders in one run
Targets Xcode XCAssets catalogs for iOS and macOS development
Single-click workflow: point it at an image folder and get all assets
caveats: README gives little detail on supported input formats, sizes, or requirements
README does not state a license
Setup and build steps are not documented; the download link is the only instruction
